# Mise en forme des nombres (virgule décimale, espace pour les milliers)
f   <- function(x, d = 3) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = " ", decimal.mark = ",")
fp  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< 0,001", f(p, 3))
et  <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "\\*\\*\\*", ifelse(p < 0.01, "\\*\\*",
                   ifelse(p < 0.05, "\\*", ifelse(p < 0.1, ".", ""))))
pct <- function(b) f(100 * (exp(b) - 1), 1)            # effet en % d'un coefficient sur un log
cf  <- function(r, v, col = 1) if (v %in% rownames(r)) r[v, col] else NA_real_
tab <- function(df, caption, align = NULL) {
  esc <- function(x) gsub("$", "\\$", x, fixed = TRUE)
  names(df) <- esc(names(df))
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) if (is.character(x)) esc(x) else x)
  kable(df, caption = caption, align = align, row.names = FALSE)
}
mois <- c("janvier", "février", "mars", "avril", "mai", "juin", "juillet", "août",
          "septembre", "octobre", "novembre", "décembre")
date_fr <- "11 novembre 2026"

IAF6110 – Devoir 1 : code R et résultats

Cette page accompagne le rapport du devoir 1 du cours IAF6110 – Modélisation statistique en intelligence d’affaires (UQAT, automne 2026). Elle présente, question par question, le code R exécuté et les résultats qu’il produit. Les tableaux et les figures sont numérotés comme dans le rapport.

Question 1

1a – Revenu familial en 1975

Données et démarche

if (requireNamespace("Ecdat", quietly = TRUE)) {
  data("Mroz", package = "Ecdat")
} else {   # mêmes 753 ménages, diffusés aussi dans AER::PSID1976
  data("PSID1976", package = "AER")
  Mroz <- with(PSID1976, data.frame(
    hoursw = hours, child6 = youngkids, child618 = oldkids, agew = age,
    educw = education, hearnw = wage, wagew = repwage, hoursh = hhours,
    ageh = hage, educh = heducation, wageh = hwage, income = fincome,
    educwm = meducation, educwf = feducation, unemprate = unemp,
    city = city, experience = experience))
}
# Participation recalculée à partir des heures travaillées
Mroz$participe <- factor(ifelse(Mroz$hoursw > 0, "oui", "non"))
Mroz$city      <- factor(Mroz$city)
s <- summary(Mroz$income)
tab(data.frame(Statistique = c("Minimum", "1er quartile", "Médiane", "Moyenne",
                               "3e quartile", "Maximum", "Observations"),
               `Revenu familial ($)` = c(f(as.numeric(s), 0), f(nrow(Mroz), 0)),
               check.names = FALSE),
    "Tableau 1 – Revenu familial en 1975", align = c("l", "r"))

Figure 1 – Distribution du logarithme du revenu familial (1975) 

m1 <- lm(log(income) ~ educw + educh + agew + ageh + experience +
           child6 + child618 + city + unemprate, data = Mroz)
m2 <- lm(log(income) ~ educw + educh + agew + ageh + experience +
           child6 + child618 + city + unemprate +
           participe + hoursw + hoursh + log(wageh), data = Mroz)
av <- anova(m1, m2); bp <- bptest(m2); vf <- vif(m2)
c1 <- summary(m1)$coefficients
c2 <- coeftest(m2, vcov = vcovHC(m2, type = "HC1"))   # erreurs-types robustes

Résultats

noms <- c("(Intercept)" = "Constante", educw = "Scolarité de l'épouse (an)",
          educh = "Scolarité du mari (an)", agew = "Âge de l'épouse", ageh = "Âge du mari",
          experience = "Expérience de l'épouse", child6 = "Enfants de moins de 6 ans",
          child618 = "Enfants de 6 à 18 ans", cityyes = "Grande ville (SMSA)",
          unemprate = "Chômage du comté (pt)", participeoui = "Participation de l'épouse",
          hoursw = "Heures de l'épouse", hoursh = "Heures du mari",
          "log(wageh)" = "log(salaire horaire du mari)")
cell <- function(cfm, v) {
  if (!v %in% rownames(cfm)) return(c("–", "–"))
  b <- cfm[v, 1]
  c(paste0(if (abs(b) < 0.001) f(b, 6) else f(b, 4), et(cfm[v, 4])), fp(cfm[v, 4]))
}
t2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(rownames(c2), function(v) {
  a <- cell(c1, v); b <- cell(c2, v)
  data.frame(Variable = noms[v], `M1 : bêta` = a[1], `M1 : p` = a[2],
             `M2 : bêta` = b[1], `M2 : p (robuste)` = b[2], check.names = FALSE)
}))
t2 <- rbind(t2, data.frame(Variable = "R² ajusté", `M1 : bêta` = f(summary(m1)$adj.r.squared, 3),
                           `M1 : p` = "", `M2 : bêta` = f(summary(m2)$adj.r.squared, 3),
                           `M2 : p (robuste)` = "", check.names = FALSE))
tab(t2, "Tableau 2 – Déterminants du logarithme du revenu familial (n = 753)",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))

1b – Évaluation des chargés de cours

Données et démarche

data("InstEval", package = "lme4")
ie <- InstEval
ie$studage <- factor(ie$studage, ordered = FALSE)
ie$lectage <- factor(ie$lectage, ordered = FALSE)
n_d <- summary(as.vector(table(ie$d)))
m0    <- lmer(y ~ 1 + (1 | s) + (1 | d), data = ie, REML = TRUE)
m_fix <- lmer(y ~ service + lectage + studage + dept + (1 | s) + (1 | d), data = ie, REML = TRUE)
m0_ml    <- update(m0, REML = FALSE)
m_fix_ml <- update(m_fix, REML = FALSE)
m_int_ml <- lmer(y ~ service * dept + lectage + studage + (1 | s) + (1 | d), data = ie, REML = FALSE)
ols <- lm(y ~ service + lectage + studage + dept, data = ie)

Résultats

vc0 <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m0)); vcf <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m_fix))
icc <- vc0$vcov / sum(vc0$vcov)
tab(data.frame(Source = c("Étudiant", "Chargé de cours", "Résiduelle"),
               `Variance (modèle nul)` = f(vc0$vcov, 4), ICC = paste0(f(100 * icc, 1), " %"),
               `Variance (modèle final)` = f(vcf$vcov, 4),
               `Écart-type (modèle final)` = f(vcf$sdcor, 3), check.names = FALSE),
    "Tableau 4 – Décomposition de la variance des évaluations", align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))

1c – Produit intérieur brut et PIB en parité de pouvoir d’achat

a. Extraction des données

indicateurs <- c(
  pib_hab = "NY.GDP.PCAP.KD", pib_hab_ppa = "NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD", inflation = "FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG",
  ide = "BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS", exportations = "NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS", importations = "NE.IMP.GNFS.ZS",
  fbcf = "NE.GDI.TOTL.ZS", conso_gouv = "NE.CON.GOVT.ZS", pib_ppa_total = "NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD",
  scol_prim = "SE.PRM.ENRR", scol_sec = "SE.SEC.ENRR", scol_ter = "SE.TER.ENRR",
  alphabetisation = "SE.ADT.LITR.ZS", depenses_educ = "SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS",
  esperance_vie = "SP.DYN.LE00.IN", fecondite = "SP.DYN.TFRT.IN", mortalite_inf = "SP.DYN.IMRT.IN",
  population = "SP.POP.TOTL", croiss_pop = "SP.POP.GROW", cpia_genre = "IQ.CPA.GNDR.XQ",
  cpia_propriete = "IQ.CPA.PROP.XQ", energie_renouv = "EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS",
  terres_agri = "AG.LND.AGRI.ZS", croiss_urb = "SP.URB.GROW", chomage = "SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS",
  participation = "SL.TLF.CACT.ZS", emploi_agri = "SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS",
  emploi_ind = "SL.IND.EMPL.ZS", emploi_serv = "SL.SRV.EMPL.ZS")

options(timeout = 600)                 # l'API peut dépasser le délai de 60 secondes
fichier <- "wdi_raw.csv"               # copie locale des données extraites
wdi <- if (file.exists(fichier)) read.csv(fichier) else
  WDI(country = "all", indicator = indicateurs, start = 2000, end = 2023, extra = TRUE)
for (essai in 1:3) {                   # nouvelle tentative pour un indicateur manquant
  manq <- setdiff(names(indicateurs), names(wdi))
  if (length(manq) == 0) break
  for (v in manq) {
    sup <- tryCatch(WDI(country = "all", indicator = indicateurs[v], start = 2000, end = 2023),
                    error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL)
    if (!is.null(sup) && v %in% names(sup))
      wdi <- merge(wdi, sup[, c("iso2c", "year", v)], by = c("iso2c", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
  }
}
write.csv(wdi, fichier, row.names = FALSE)
noms_wdi <- intersect(names(indicateurs), names(wdi))
wdi <- subset(wdi, region != "Aggregates" & !is.na(region))

b. Démarche de modélisation

per  <- subset(wdi, year >= 2015 & year <= 2019)
pays <- aggregate(per[, noms_wdi], by = list(iso3c = per$iso3c), FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))
pays[] <- lapply(pays, function(x) { x[is.nan(x)] <- NA; x })
na_pays <- colMeans(is.na(pays[, noms_wdi]))
raison <- setNames(rep("Retenu", length(noms_wdi)), noms_wdi)
raison[na_pays > 0.40] <- "Exclu : plus de 40 % de valeurs manquantes"
raison[c("pib_hab", "pib_hab_ppa")] <- "Variable expliquée"
raison["pib_ppa_total"] <- "Exclu : PIB/hab PPA × population"
raison["emploi_serv"]   <- "Exclu : agriculture + industrie + services = 100 %"
raison["population"]    <- "Retenu en logarithme"
predicteurs <- c(setdiff(noms_wdi[raison == "Retenu"], "population"), "log_pop")
pays$log_pib <- log(pays$pib_hab); pays$log_pib_ppa <- log(pays$pib_hab_ppa)
pays$log_pop <- log(pays$population)
for (v in predicteurs) pays[[v]][is.na(pays[[v]])] <- median(pays[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
base <- subset(pays, !is.na(log_pib) & !is.na(log_pib_ppa))
lib_wdi <- c(pib_hab = "PIB par habitant ($ constants)", pib_hab_ppa = "PIB par habitant PPA",
  inflation = "Inflation (%)", ide = "IDE entrants (% du PIB)", exportations = "Exportations (% du PIB)",
  importations = "Importations (% du PIB)", fbcf = "Formation brute de capital (% du PIB)",
  conso_gouv = "Consommation publique (% du PIB)", pib_ppa_total = "PIB total PPA",
  scol_prim = "Scolarisation primaire (%)", scol_sec = "Scolarisation secondaire (%)",
  scol_ter = "Scolarisation tertiaire (%)", alphabetisation = "Alphabétisation des adultes (%)",
  depenses_educ = "Dépenses d'éducation (% du PIB)", esperance_vie = "Espérance de vie (ans)",
  fecondite = "Fécondité (enfants par femme)", mortalite_inf = "Mortalité infantile (pour 1000)",
  population = "Population", log_pop = "log(population)", croiss_pop = "Croissance démographique (%)",
  cpia_genre = "CPIA égalité des genres", cpia_propriete = "CPIA droits de propriété",
  energie_renouv = "Énergie renouvelable (%)", terres_agri = "Terres agricoles (%)",
  croiss_urb = "Croissance urbaine (%)", chomage = "Chômage (%)", participation = "Taux d'activité (%)",
  emploi_agri = "Emploi agricole (%)", emploi_ind = "Emploi industriel (%)",
  emploi_serv = "Emploi dans les services (%)")
o <- order(-na_pays)
tab(data.frame(Code = indicateurs[noms_wdi][o], Indicateur = lib_wdi[noms_wdi][o],

Résultats

m_pib <- step(lm(reformulate(predicteurs, "log_pib"), data = base), trace = 0)
m_ppa <- step(lm(reformulate(predicteurs, "log_pib_ppa"), data = base), trace = 0)
rob_pib <- coeftest(m_pib, vcov = vcovHC(m_pib, type = "HC1"))
rob_ppa <- coeftest(m_ppa, vcov = vcovHC(m_ppa, type = "HC1"))
bp_pib <- bptest(m_pib); bp_ppa <- bptest(m_ppa)
cellule <- function(r, v) if (v %in% rownames(r)) paste0(f(r[v, 1], 4), et(r[v, 4])) else "–"
vars <- union(rownames(rob_pib), rownames(rob_ppa))
t10 <- data.frame(Variable = ifelse(vars == "(Intercept)", "Constante", lib_wdi[vars]),
                  `log(PIB/hab)` = sapply(vars, function(v) cellule(rob_pib, v)),
                  `log(PIB/hab PPA)` = sapply(vars, function(v) cellule(rob_ppa, v)), check.names = FALSE)
t10 <- rbind(t10, data.frame(Variable = c("R² ajusté", "Pays"),
  `log(PIB/hab)` = c(f(summary(m_pib)$adj.r.squared, 3), nobs(m_pib)),
  `log(PIB/hab PPA)` = c(f(summary(m_ppa)$adj.r.squared, 3), nobs(m_ppa)), check.names = FALSE))
tab(t10, "Tableau 10 – Déterminants du PIB et du PIB en PPA, moyenne 2015-2019 (erreurs-types robustes)",

Question 2 – L’analyse factorielle

set.seed(6110)
n <- 400
Fl <- matrix(rnorm(n * 3), n) %*% chol(matrix(c(1, -.2, .3, -.2, 1, -.1, .3, -.1, 1), 3))
item <- function(fl, l) pmin(7, pmax(1, round(4 + 1.2 * (l * fl + sqrt(1 - l^2) * rnorm(n)))))
sond <- data.frame(
  nouv1 = item(Fl[, 1], .80), nouv2 = item(Fl[, 1], .75), nouv3 = item(Fl[, 1], .70), nouv4 = item(Fl[, 1], .65),
  prix1 = item(Fl[, 2], .80), prix2 = item(Fl[, 2], .75), prix3 = item(Fl[, 2], .70), prix4 = item(Fl[, 2], .60),
  conf1 = item(Fl[, 3], .80), conf2 = item(Fl[, 3], .75), conf3 = item(Fl[, 3], .70), conf4 = item(Fl[, 3], .65))
R <- cor(sond)

2. Analyse en composantes principales et analyse factorielle commune

acp <- principal(sond, nfactors = 3, rotate = "varimax")
afc <- fa(sond, nfactors = 3, fm = "ml", rotate = "oblimin")
charge_max <- function(L) apply(abs(unclass(L)), 1, max)
v_acp <- 100 * sum(acp$values[1:3]) / 12; v_af <- 100 * sum(afc$communality) / 12
t13 <- data.frame(Item = rownames(R), `ACP : charge` = f(charge_max(acp$loadings), 2),
                  `ACP : communauté` = f(acp$communality, 2), `AF : charge` = f(charge_max(afc$loadings), 2),
                  `AF : communauté` = f(afc$communality, 2), check.names = FALSE)
t13 <- rbind(t13, data.frame(Item = "Variance expliquée (3 dimensions)", `ACP : charge` = "",
  `ACP : communauté` = paste0(f(v_acp, 1), " %"), `AF : charge` = "",
  `AF : communauté` = paste0(f(v_af, 1), " %"), check.names = FALSE))
tab(t13, "Tableau 13 – ACP (rotation varimax) et analyse factorielle commune (maximum de vraisemblance, rotation oblimin)",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"))

Question 3 – Prédiction du prix des maisons

1. Importation des données

set.seed(6110)
d <- read.csv("housing.csv", check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
dim_brut <- dim(d)
d <- d[, !(names(d) %in% c("", "Order", "PID"))]
names(d) <- make.names(gsub("[ /]", "", names(d)))
sp <- summary(d$SalePrice)

2. Valeurs manquantes

na_avant <- sort(colSums(is.na(d))[colSums(is.na(d)) > 0], decreasing = TRUE)
mode_de <- function(x) names(which.max(table(x)))
i <- is.na(d$BsmtExposure) & !is.na(d$BsmtQual); d$BsmtExposure[i] <- mode_de(d$BsmtExposure)
i <- is.na(d$BsmtFinType2) & !is.na(d$BsmtQual); d$BsmtFinType2[i] <- mode_de(d$BsmtFinType2)
i <- !is.na(d$GarageType) & is.na(d$GarageFinish)
for (v in c("GarageFinish", "GarageQual", "GarageCond")) d[[v]][i] <- mode_de(d[[v]][d$GarageType %in% "Detchd"])
for (v in c("GarageCars", "GarageArea"))
  d[[v]][i & is.na(d[[v]])] <- median(d[[v]][d$GarageType %in% "Detchd"], na.rm = TRUE)
d$GarageYrBlt[i & is.na(d$GarageYrBlt)] <- d$YearBuilt[i & is.na(d$GarageYrBlt)]
d$Electrical[is.na(d$Electrical)] <- mode_de(d$Electrical)
for (v in c("Alley", "BsmtQual", "BsmtCond", "BsmtExposure", "BsmtFinType1", "BsmtFinType2",
            "FireplaceQu", "GarageType", "GarageFinish", "GarageQual", "GarageCond", "PoolQC",
            "Fence", "MiscFeature", "MasVnrType")) d[[v]][is.na(d[[v]])] <- "None"
for (v in c("MasVnrArea", "BsmtFinSF1", "BsmtFinSF2", "BsmtUnfSF", "TotalBsmtSF",
            "BsmtFullBath", "BsmtHalfBath", "GarageCars", "GarageArea")) d[[v]][is.na(d[[v]])] <- 0
d$GarageYrBlt[is.na(d$GarageYrBlt)] <- d$YearBuilt[is.na(d$GarageYrBlt)]
d$GarageYrBlt[d$GarageYrBlt > 2010] <- 2007
med_q <- tapply(d$LotFrontage, d$Neighborhood, median, na.rm = TRUE)
i <- is.na(d$LotFrontage); d$LotFrontage[i] <- med_q[d$Neighborhood[i]]
d$LotFrontage[is.na(d$LotFrontage)] <- median(d$LotFrontage, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(d)) == 0)
n_aberr <- sum(d$GrLivArea > 4000)
d <- d[d$GrLivArea <= 4000, ]
trait <- c(PoolQC = "Absence de piscine → « None »", MiscFeature = "Absence → « None »",

3. Variables catégoriques et encodage

echelle_q <- c(None = 0, Po = 1, Fa = 2, TA = 3, Gd = 4, Ex = 5)
ordinales <- c("ExterQual", "ExterCond", "BsmtQual", "BsmtCond", "HeatingQC", "KitchenQual",
               "FireplaceQu", "GarageQual", "GarageCond", "PoolQC")
for (v in ordinales) d[[v]] <- unname(echelle_q[d[[v]]])
d$BsmtExposure <- unname(c(None = 0, No = 1, Mn = 2, Av = 3, Gd = 4)[d$BsmtExposure])
fin <- c(None = 0, Unf = 1, LwQ = 2, Rec = 3, BLQ = 4, ALQ = 5, GLQ = 6)
d$BsmtFinType1 <- unname(fin[d$BsmtFinType1]); d$BsmtFinType2 <- unname(fin[d$BsmtFinType2])
d$GarageFinish <- unname(c(None = 0, Unf = 1, RFn = 2, Fin = 3)[d$GarageFinish])
d$CentralAir   <- as.integer(d$CentralAir == "Y")
d$MSSubClass <- as.character(d$MSSubClass); d$MoSold <- as.character(d$MoSold)
d$TotalSF   <- d$TotalBsmtSF + d$X1stFlrSF + d$X2ndFlrSF
d$AgeVente  <- d$YrSold - d$YearBuilt
d$AgeRenov  <- d$YrSold - d$YearRemodAdd
d$TotalBain <- d$FullBath + 0.5 * d$HalfBath + d$BsmtFullBath + 0.5 * d$BsmtHalfBath
nominales <- names(d)[sapply(d, is.character)]
for (v in nominales) {
  tb <- table(d[[v]]); d[[v]][d[[v]] %in% names(tb)[tb < 10]] <- "Autre"; d[[v]] <- factor(d[[v]])
}
d$logPrix <- log(d$SalePrice)
asym <- c(brut = skewness(d$SalePrice), log = skewness(d$logPrix))
X <- model.matrix(logPrix ~ . - SalePrice, data = d)[, -1]
X <- X[, colSums(X != 0) >= 10]; X <- X[, apply(X, 2, sd) > 0]
colnames(X) <- make.names(colnames(X), unique = TRUE)
y <- d$logPrix
tab(data.frame(
  Traitement = c("Ordinales → entiers ordonnés", "Binaire → 0 / 1", "Codes numériques → catégories",

               "TotalSF, AgeVente, AgeRenov, TotalBain", "Retirées", "Matrice X"),
  Nombre = c(length(ordinales) + 4, 1, 2, length(nominales), 4, "–", ncol(X))),
  "Tableau 18 – Encodage des variables", align = c("l", "l", "r"))

4. Sélection des variables

idx <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
Xtr <- X[idx, ]; ytr <- y[idx]; Xte <- X[-idx, ]; yte <- y[-idx]
plis <- createFolds(ytr, k = 5, returnTrain = TRUE)
ctrl <- trainControl(method = "cv", index = plis, savePredictions = "final")
cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(Xtr, ytr, alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
b_lasso  <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.1se")
retenues <- setdiff(rownames(b_lasso)[as.vector(b_lasso != 0)], "(Intercept)")
coefs_tri <- sort(abs(b_lasso[retenues, 1]) * apply(Xtr[, retenues], 2, sd), decreasing = TRUE)
num <- d[, sapply(d, is.numeric) & !(names(d) %in% c("SalePrice", "logPrix"))]
cor_y <- sort(abs(cor(num, d$logPrix))[, 1], decreasing = TRUE)
par(mar = c(5, 5, 6, 2))
plot(cv_lasso, ylab = "Erreur quadratique moyenne (validation croisée)")
title(paste0("Choix de la pénalité du LASSO : ", length(retenues), " variables retenues (lambda.1se)"), line = 4)

Figure 10 – Choix de la pénalité du LASSO par validation croisée

}

5. Neuf modèles de régression

top10 <- names(cor_y)[1:10]
tr_df <- data.frame(Xtr, logPrix = ytr, check.names = FALSE)
m_step <- stepAIC(lm(logPrix ~ ., data = tr_df[, c(retenues, "logPrix")]),
                  direction = "both", k = log(nrow(tr_df)), trace = 0)
vars_step <- gsub("`", "", attr(terms(m_step), "term.labels"))
grille_l <- 10^seq(-4, 0, length = 40)
modeles <- list()
modeles$`M1 MCO (top 10 corr.)` <- train(x = Xtr[, top10], y = ytr, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl)
modeles$`M2 MCO post-LASSO stepwise` <- train(x = Xtr[, vars_step], y = ytr, method = "lm", trControl = ctrl)
modeles$`M3 Ridge` <- train(Xtr, ytr, method = "glmnet", trControl = ctrl, preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
                            tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 0, lambda = grille_l * 10))
modeles$`M4 LASSO` <- train(Xtr, ytr, method = "glmnet", trControl = ctrl, preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
                            tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 1, lambda = grille_l))
modeles$`M5 Elastic Net` <- train(Xtr, ytr, method = "glmnet", trControl = ctrl,
                                  preProcess = c("center", "scale"),
                                  tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = c(.1, .3, .5, .7, .9), lambda = grille_l))
modeles$`M6 Arbre (CART)` <- train(Xtr, ytr, method = "rpart", trControl = ctrl, tuneLength = 15)
modeles$`M7 Forêt aléatoire` <- train(Xtr, ytr, method = "ranger", trControl = ctrl, num.trees = 500,
                                      importance = "permutation",
                                      tuneGrid = expand.grid(mtry = c(15, 30, 60), splitrule = "variance",
                                                             min.node.size = 5))
modeles$`M8 Gradient boosting` <- train(Xtr, ytr, method = "gbm", trControl = ctrl, verbose = FALSE,
                                        tuneGrid = expand.grid(n.trees = c(1000, 2000),
                                                               interaction.depth = c(3, 5),
                                                               shrinkage = 0.02, n.minobsinnode = 10))
modeles$`M9 SVR (radial)` <- train(Xtr, ytr, method = "svmRadial", trControl = ctrl,
                                   preProcess = c("center", "scale"), tuneLength = 5)
bt <- lapply(modeles, function(m) m$bestTune)
tab(data.frame(Modèle = names(modeles),
  Principe = c("MCO sur les 10 variables les plus corrélées", "MCO sur les variables du LASSO, puis pas à pas (BIC)",
               "Pénalité L2 : rétrécit tous les coefficients", "Pénalité L1 : annule les coefficients inutiles",
               "Combinaison des pénalités L1 et L2", "Découpages successifs des données",
               "500 arbres construits sur des échantillons bootstrap", "Arbres ajoutés un à un pour corriger les erreurs",
               "Régression à vecteurs de support, noyau radial"),
  `Hyperparamètres retenus` = c(paste(length(top10), "variables"), paste(length(vars_step), "variables"),
    paste0("lambda = ", f(bt$`M3 Ridge`$lambda, 4)), paste0("lambda = ", f(bt$`M4 LASSO`$lambda, 4)),
    paste0("alpha = ", f(bt$`M5 Elastic Net`$alpha, 1), " ; lambda = ", f(bt$`M5 Elastic Net`$lambda, 4)),
    paste0("cp = ", f(bt$`M6 Arbre (CART)`$cp, 4)), paste0("mtry = ", bt$`M7 Forêt aléatoire`$mtry),
    paste0(bt$`M8 Gradient boosting`$n.trees, " arbres ; profondeur ", bt$`M8 Gradient boosting`$interaction.depth),
    paste0("C = ", bt$`M9 SVR (radial)`$C, " ; sigma = ", f(bt$`M9 SVR (radial)`$sigma, 4))),
  check.names = FALSE),
  "Tableau 20 – Les neuf modèles comparés", align = c("l", "l", "l"))

6. Évaluation et recommandation

vars_mod <- setNames(rep(list(colnames(Xtr)), length(modeles)), names(modeles))
vars_mod$`M1 MCO (top 10 corr.)` <- top10; vars_mod$`M2 MCO post-LASSO stepwise` <- vars_step
eval_test <- function(k) {
  p <- predict(modeles[[k]], newdata = as.data.frame(Xte[, vars_mod[[k]], drop = FALSE]))
  c(RMSE_log = sqrt(mean((yte - p)^2)), R2_log = 1 - sum((yte - p)^2) / sum((yte - mean(yte))^2),
    MAE_dollars = mean(abs(exp(yte) - exp(p))), MAPE_pct = 100 * mean(abs(exp(yte) - exp(p)) / exp(yte)))
}
res <- data.frame(CV = sapply(modeles, function(m) min(m$results$RMSE)),
                  CV_sd = sapply(modeles, function(m) m$results$RMSESD[which.min(m$results$RMSE)]),
                  t(sapply(names(modeles), eval_test)), check.names = FALSE)
res <- res[order(res$RMSE_log), ]
p_ens <- (predict(modeles$`M5 Elastic Net`, as.data.frame(Xte)) +
          predict(modeles$`M8 Gradient boosting`, as.data.frame(Xte))) / 2
rmse_ens <- sqrt(mean((yte - p_ens)^2))
t21 <- data.frame(Modèle = rownames(res), `Validation croisée : RMSE (± é.-t.)` = paste0(f(res$CV, 4), " ± ", f(res$CV_sd, 4)),
                  `Test : RMSE` = f(res$RMSE_log, 4), `Test : R²` = f(res$R2_log, 3),
                  `Erreur moyenne ($)` = f(res$MAE_dollars, 0), `Erreur moyenne (%)` = f(res$MAPE_pct, 1),
                  check.names = FALSE)
t21 <- rbind(t21, data.frame(Modèle = "Moyenne Elastic Net + boosting", `Validation croisée : RMSE (± é.-t.)` = "–",
                             `Test : RMSE` = f(rmse_ens, 4), `Test : R²` = "–", `Erreur moyenne ($)` = "–",
                             `Erreur moyenne (%)` = "–", check.names = FALSE))
tab(t21, paste0("Tableau 21 – Performances des modèles (RMSE sur le log du prix ; test : ", length(yte),
                " maisons jamais vues)"), align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
